research_topic: Improve multimodal architecture fault tolerance through adaptive fusion mechanisms for missing input robustness in federated learning environments regarding performance degradation minimization when visual, audio, or text modalities are unavailable, evaluated on MM-GRAPH benchmarks and multimodal reasoning tasks using 1-3B parameter models with parameter-efficient adaptation, addressing the 2025 distributed AI challenge by implementing uncertainty-aware feature alignment and modality-specific attention weighting for robust deployment in resource-constrained and communication-limited scenarios.
